comments.body:
Obtained from a treasure map 'Holy mans notes' in St. Petersburg theology archive. Requires r13 theology to pull and r13 search/unlock to use. Map leads to Inland Crete, center of the map.

Stats : Durability 40/40, 20 Defence Power, +1 Evasion, +1 Tactics. Required Total Fame 6000
